summary.text: A 27-30 m fishing vessel sunk on purpose in Golfo Nuevo off Puerto Madryn to make a dive site. It rests at roughly 15-24 m, is rated medium difficulty, and is covered in life such as tube anemones and large salmon fish.

s2.quote: Miralles En marzo del 2004 fue hundido el buque Antonio Miralles … Profundidad máxima de 28 mts. con marea alta y 20 mts. con marea baja.

highlights.text: Large interior spaces allow safe penetration to bridge

summary.text: The Antonio Miralles was sunk in March 2004 in Golfo Nuevo off Puerto Madryn as an artificial dive site. It lies about 20-30 m deep depending on tide, is rated medium to hard, and its roomy interior allows penetration.
